name: Columbia (STS-107)
about: Columbia (STS-107) (2003-003A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 2003 Jan 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (D).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2003 Jan 23), held fixed
